intro: Search the ingested files for a term, an identifier such as an IP address or a part number, or a question. "-word" leaves out hits with that word, "two words" in quotes is a phrase.
empty: Enter a term, an identifier or a question and press Enter.
noHits: No hits. Try other words, or search all devices.

semantic.unavailable: Keyword search only – language model not reachable

hint.exact: An identifier from the search, such as an IP address or a part number, appears word for word in the text.
hint.keyword: The words of the search appear in the text, also in other forms, such as the plural.
hint.semantic: The text matches the search in meaning, even without the same words (AI search).

olderVersionHint: This file has a newer version that is not searchable yet.
